Hammikach eno nikne bidvarim. vaafillu heidu alehem edim. ketzad. bayit ze ani mocher lecha. yayin ze ani mocher lecha. eved ze ani mocher lecha. ufasku haddamim veratza hallokeach veamar kaniti. veratza hammocher veamar macharti. veamru laedim hevu alenu edim shemmachar ze veshellakach ze. hare ze eno kelum ucheillu lo hayu benehem devarim meolam. vechen benoten mattana umekabbelah: 
Aval im nikna hammikkach beechad mehaddevarim shehu nikne bahem kana hallokeach veenan tzerichin leedim kelal veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo: 
Uvema yikkane hammikkach. hakkarkaot beechad mishshelosha devarim. bechesef. o bishtar. o bachazaka: 
Ketzad bechesef. machar lo bayit machar lo sade venatan lo haddamim kana. bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheen kotvin et hashshetar. aval bemakom sheddarkan lichtov shetar mecher lo kana ad sheyyichtov et hashshetar. veen karka niknet befachot mishsheve peruta: 
Hitna hallokeach veamar im ratziti ekne bechesef o ekne bishtar. venatan hakkesef al tenay ze. hare ze kayyam veen hammocher yachol lachzor bo mippene hattenay. vehallokeach yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyichtov et hashshetar. vechen im hitna hammocher kaze: 
Haomer lachavero ten mane lifloni veyikkane beti lecha. kevan shennatan kana habbayit middin arev: 
Ketzad bishtar. katav lo al hanneyar o al hacheres o al heale sadi netuna lecha sadi mechura lecha kevan shehiggia hashshetar leyado kana. af al pi sheen sham edim kelal. veaf al pi sheen hashshetar shave kelum. bamme devarim amurim bemocher sade mippene raatah. aval bishar karkaot af al pi shehiggia shetar shel mecher leyado vaafillu hayu bo edim lo kana ad sheyyitten et haddamim: 
Ketzad bachazaka. machar lo bayit machar lo sade o shennatan otah bemattana kevan shennaal o gadar o paratz kol shehu vehu sheyyoil bemaasav hare ze kana. bamme devarim amurim keshehechezik bifne hammocher o hannoten. aval shello bifne hammocher o hannoten tzarich sheyyomar lo lech chazzek ukene veachar kach im hechezik kana af al pi sheeno bifne habbealim:
Hammocher bayit lachavero umasar lo et hammafteach hare ze kemi sheamar lo lech chazzek ukene. vechen hammocher et habbor kevan shemmasar lo dilyo hare ze kemi sheamar lo lech chazzek ukene, ucheshehechezik yikne:
Ketzad hammachazik binila kana. kegon shemmachar bayit o chatzer vehaya happetach patuach venaal hallokeach et happetach vechazar ufetacho hare ze hechezik vekana. shehare nishtammesh bah shimmush hammoil:
Ketzad hammachazik bigdira kol shehu kana. kegon shehaya sham gader vehayu olin benachat. vehosif alav kol shehu vehishlimo laasara venimtza sheen olin ella bedochak. hare ze hoil vekana. vechen im hayta sham pirtza vehayu nichnasim bah bedochak vehirchiv hu bah kol shehu ad shennimtza nichnas berevach. hare hoil vekana: 
Natan tzeror vehoil. kegon shechibber bo hammayim lassade. o natal tzeror vehoil kegon sheppatach bintilato hammayim lassade. hare ze kana. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammocher sade lachavero betzad sadehu. o shennetanah lo bemattana. kevan sheddash et hammetzar shebben shete hassadot venaasu shetehen kesade achat kana. aval im halach bah learkah ulerachbah en hilluch ze moil kelum. veim shevil shel keramim machar lo hoil venaasa lehilluch kana behilluch: 
Vechamma shiur rochav hadderech sheyyikne behillucho. im haya mesuyyam bimchitztzot kana kede sheyyagbiah regel veyanniach regel betziddah. veim en sham mechitztzot kana barochav kede shettihye al rosho chavila shel sarigim veyasov bah: 
Hayta hakkarka tzechiach sela sheen bah lo gader velo pirtza. veenah bat zeria. hare hachazaka shekkona otah shetichat perot o haamadat behema sham vechayyotze baze mishshear hattashmish: 
Hammocher sade lachavero venichnas bah hallokeach uzeraah o narah. o sheasaf perot hailan o zemaro vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hare ze kana shehare hechezik. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. vechen im asaf hammocher sal shel perot venatan lallokeach. kana lokeach miyyad bachazaka. shehare gilla dato shehikna lo sade zo kinyan gamur venaasu peroteha shello: 
Haakkum eno kone bachazaka. ella bishtar hu shekkone im netinat hakkesef. veyisrael habba mechamat haakkum hare hu keakkum veeno kone ella bishtar. kol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kekarka. venikne o bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka. veim eno tzarich lakkarka kegon anavim haomdot libbatzer hare ze kemittaltelin lekinyan veyesh lahen onaa:
Keshem shehakkarka nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka. kach sechirut hakkarka nikne bechesef levaddo o bishtar levaddo o bachazaka. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo:
Hammocher lachavero eser sadot beeser medinot. kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana kullan. vaafillu hayta achat mehen har gavoah vehashshenit metzula shehare tashmish shel zo enah tashmish shel zo. af al pi chen kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana hashshear:
Bamme devarim amurim. shennatan deme kullan. aval im lo natan deme kullan lo kana ella keneged meotav. lefichach im hayu hakkol bemattana kana kullan. vechen bischirut kevan shehechzik beachat mehen kana kullan kol zeman hassechirut. hayu miktzat hakkarkaot bemecher umiktzatan bischirut. kevan shehechzik ben bimchira ben bischirut kana hakkol:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 2:
Eved kenaani hare hu kekarka likniyya venikne bechesef uvishtar o bachazaka: 
Uma hi hachazaka bekinyan avadim. sheyyishtammesh bahen kederech shemmishtammeshin baavadim bifne rabbo. ketzad. hittir lo minalo o shehinil lo minalo. o sheholich kelav levet hammerchatz. o shehifshito o sacho o gerdo o hilbisho o higbiah et rabbo kana. vechen im higbiah harav et haeved kana: 
Tekafo vehevio etzlo kana. shehaavadim niknin bimshicha kazo. aval im kara laeved uva etzlo. o sheamar lo rabbo harishon lech etzel hallokeach vehalach etzlo. lo kana ad sheyyimshechennu bitkifa o sheyyishtammesh bo kemo shebbearnu. veim hechezik bo shello bifne harav tzarich sheyyomar lo lech chazzek ukene: 
Eved katan hare hu kivhema vekonin oto bidvarim shekkonin bahen habbehema uvidvarim shekkonin bahen haavadim. lefichach nikne bimshicha af al pi shello tokfo: 
Habbehema ben dakka ben gassa niknet bimshicha af al pi sheefshar lehagebiah otah lo hitzrichuhu lehagebiah. mippene shemmitchabbetet baaretz. veim higbiah kana. vehahagbaha kona bechol makom. aval hammeshicha en konin bah ella besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem veen konin bah birshut harabbim velo bechatzer sheenah shel shenehem: 
Ketzad konin et habbehema bimshicha. en tzarich lomar im meshachah vehalcha o sherachav aleha vehalcha bo shekkana. ella afillu kara lah uvaa o shehikkishah bemakkel veratza befanav kevan sheakra yad veregel kenaah. vehu sheyyimshoch bifne habbealim. aval im mashach shello bifne habbealim tzarich sheyyomar lo kodem sheyyimshoch lech meshoch ukene: 
Hammocher eder lachavero o shennatan lo bemattana. kevan shemmasar lo mashkuchit, hi habbehema hamehallechet berosh haeder vehakkol nimshachim achareha, en tzarich lomar lo meshoch ukene. shemmesirat behema zo kemi sheamar lo lech meshoch ukene. vechevan shemmashach lo haeder kana veaf al pi shemmashach shello befanav: 
Haomer lachavero meshoch vetikne o chazzek vetikne vechayyotze bidvarim ellu vehalach umashach o shehechzik lo kana shemmashma tikne lehabba vaadayin lo hikna lo. ella tzarich hammocher o hannoten lomar lo lech chazzek ukene o meshoch ukene vechayyotze bidvarim ellu shemmashmaan sheyyikne atta beet sheyyimshoch o yachazik: 
Haomer lachavero meshoch para zo velo tikne ella leachar sheloshim yom umashach lo kana. veim amar lo kene meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom kana. vaafillu hayta omedet baagam beyom sheloshim. shezze kemi shehikna oto meatta al tenay naasa hattenay nitkayyem hakkinyan. vechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav dami: 
Hammocher behema lachavero o netanah lo bemattana veamar kene otah kederech shebbene adam konin. im mashach o higbihah kana. aval im rachav aleha. im bassade kana. veim bair lo kana. lefi sheen derech bene adam lirkov bair. lefichach im haya adam chashuv sheddarko lirkov bair. o adam mezulzal beyoter sheeno makpid al hillucho bair rochev. kegon hametappelin begiddul habbehemot o haavadim. o shehayta ishsha. o shehaya birshut harabbim sheharabbim dorsin sham. hare ze kone birchiva. vehu shettehallech bo:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 3:
Echad habbehema veechad shear hammittaltelin niknin bemaot din tora. umishshennatan et hammaot kana veen echad mehen yuchal lachzor bo. aval chachamim tikkenu shello yiknu hammittaltelin ella behagebaha o bimshichat davar sheen darko lehagebiah: 
Ketzad. hamekabbetz etzim o pishtan vechayyotze bahen veasa mehen taun gadol shei efshar lehagebiho. eno nikne bimshicha. shehare efshar lehattir haeged ulehagbiho etz etz. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im haya taun shel egozim o shel pilpelin o shel shekedim vechayyotze bahen vehaya gadol sheen echad yuchal lehagebiho. hare ze nikne bimshicha. sheim yattiro yitpared veyihye lo bo torach gadol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hassefina hoil vei efshar lehagebihah veyesh bimshichatah torach gadol veenah nimshechet ella larabbim. lo hitzrichuha meshicha ella niknet bimsira. vechen kol kayyotze baze. veim amar lo hammocher lech meshoch ukene eno kone hassefina ad sheyyimshechenna kullah veyotziennah mikkol hammakom shehayta bo. shehare hikpid hammocher shello yikne ze ella bimshicha: 
Nimtzeta lamed shehallokeach mittaltelin af al pi shennatan kol haddamim yachol lachzor bo. vechen hammocher yachol lachzor bo ad sheyyagbiah o yimshoch davar sheen bo hagebaha. o yimsor hammocher lallokeach davar sheen darko lehameshich. umishshehigbiah o mashach davar sheen darko lehagebiah o nimsar lo davar sheen darko lehameshich kana veen echad mishshenehem yachol lachzor bo. vechofin et hallokeach litten et haddamim: 
Velamma tiknu chachamim davar ze bemittaltelin. gezera shemma yitten hallokeach deme hachefetz vekodem sheyyikkachennu yovad beones. uchegon shennafla deleka venisraf. o bau listim unetaluhu. im yihye birshut hallokeach yitmahmeah hammocher velo yatztzilehu. lefichach heemiduhu chachamim birshut hammocher kede sheyyishtaddel vayyatztziyil hachefetz. sheim avad chayyav leshallem: 
Nimtzeta omer sheim natan deme hammikkach veneenas kodem sheyyikkachennu. veamar lo hallokeach ten li mikkachi o hachezer li et meotay. veaf al pi sheyyesh edim sheavad beones velo haya bammocher koach lehatztzilo velo nitrashshel baddavar. hare ze machzir et haddamim. shehare tikkenu chachamim meshicha. lefichach im haya beto shel lokeach sheyyesh bo hachefetz shennimkar muskar lammocher lo tikkenu lo chachamim meshicha. shehare hammikkach birshut hallokeach. umishshennatan et haddamim nikna hammikkach veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo: 
Vechen hassocher hammakom sheotan hammittaltelin hannimkarin munnachin bo kana. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo veaf al pi shello higbiah velo mashach velo nimseru lo. shehare naasa birshuto. uchevar bearnu shessechirut karka nikne bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka: 
Hammakne karka umittaltelin keechad kevan shekkana karka bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka niknu hammittaltelin immahem ben shehayu shenehem bemecher o bemattana. ben shemmachar mittaltelin venatan karka. ben shemmachar hakkarka venatan hammittaltelin. kevan shekkana karka kana mittaltelin: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu otan hammittaltelin tzevurin beotah karka. aval im hayu bemakom acher tzarich sheyyomar lo kene mittaltelin aggav karka. afillu hayu hammittaltelin bimdina acheret veamar lo kene otam al gabbe karka pelonit kevan shekkana hakkarka niknu hammittaltelin af al pi sheenan tzevurin betochah. veim lo amar kene aggav karka lo kana. vekarka kol shehi konin al gabbah kol mittaltelin sheyyirtze: 
Hikna hassade leechad vehammittaltelin leacher af al pi sheamar lo kene hammittaltelin al gabbe karka vehechezik haechad bakkarka lo kana hashsheni hammittaltelin. veim tefasan achar shechazar bo hammakne en motziin miyyado. shehare tefasan achar shekkana chavero hakkarka shenniknu ellu al gabbo: 
Hammakne avadim vekarkaot keechad hechezik baavadim lo kana hakkarkaot. hechezik bekarkaot lo kana avadim ad sheyyihyu omdin betoch hakkarka. veaf al pi sheamar lo kene avadim al gabbe karka lo kana ad sheyyihyu betochah. shehaeved mehallech ledaat atzmo: 
Hammakne avadim umittaltelin keechad mashach hammittaltelin lo kana haavadim hechezik baavadim lo kana hammittaltelin. ella im ken hayu hammittaltelin al gav haeved. vehu sheyyihye kafut shehare eno yachol lehallech: 
Hammakne behema vechelim sheal gabbah keechad af al pi shemmashach habbehema ukenaah lo kana hakkelim shealeha ad sheyyagbiah o yimshoch hakkelim atzman im en darkan lehagebihan. shehabbehema kechatzer hammithallechet hi veen ma shebbetochah kanuy levalah. lefichach im hayta habbehema kefuta kana af kelim shealeha: 
Amar lo hammakne meshoch behema ukene kelim shealeha. hoil velo hikna lo guf habbehema af al pi shemmeshachah vehi kefuta lo kana kelim shealeha ad sheyyimshoch hakkelim atzman: 
Haya atzitz nakuv leechad vehayu hazzeraim shebbo leacher. hikna heatzitz levaal hazzeraim kevan shemmashach kana. hikna hazzeraim levaal heatzitz lo kana ad sheyyachzik bazzeraim atzman: 
Haya heatzitz vehazzeraim shebbo leechad vehikna hakkol leacher vehechezik baatzitz liknot hazzeraim af heatzitz lo kana. hechezik bazzeraim kana heatzitz. vezehu sheshshaninu nechasim sheen lahen acharayut niknim im nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut. shehazzeraim shebbeatzitz nakuv zeruim hem baaretz vechol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kekarka kemo shebbearnu: 
Kevar bearnu shekkol haomed libbatzer kevatzur dami veeno nikne ella behagebaha o bishar devarim shenniknim bahen hammittaltelim: 
Pishtan keshehu mechubbar lakkarka veyavesh sheeno tzarich lakkarka veamar lo yappe li karka kol shehu ukene kol ma shealeha. kevan shettalash kol shehu kana hakkol mippene hattenay hazze. aval im (amar lo) hikna lo happishtan hazze bemecher o bemattana lo kana ella ma shettalash shehare higbiho. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 4:
Kelio shel adam kol makom sheyyesh lo reshut lehannicho kana lo. kevan shennichnesu hammittaltelin betoch hakkeli en echad mehen yachol lachzor bo vahare ze kemo shehigbihan o kemo shehunnechu betoch beto. lefichach en kelyo shel adam kone lo birshut harabbim velo birshut hammocher. ella im amar lo hammakne lech ukene bichli ze. vechen im kana hakkeli techilla vehigbiho veachar kach hinnicho sham birshut hammocher vechazar vekana mimmennu happerot. kevan shennichnesu betoch keli ze kana otam. mippene shehanaat hammocher bimchirat hakkeli eno makpid al mekomo: 
Keshem sheen kelyo shel lokeach kone lo birshut mocher kach en kelyo shel mocher kone lallokeach af al pi shehu birshut hallokeach: 
Mesira enah kona ella birshut harabbim uvechatzer sheenah shel shenehem. vehammeshicha enah kona ella besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem. vehagebaha kona bechol makom: 
Davar hannikne bimshicha im haya birshut harabbim umeshacho hallokeach lirshuto o lesimta. kevan shehotzi miktzat hachefetz mershut harabbim kana: 
Taun shel perot shehaya munnach birshut harabbim umeshacho lokeach lirshuto o lesimta achar sheppasak haddamim kana af al pi sheadayin lo madad. vechen im medadan hallokeach birshut harabbim kana rishon rishon behagebaha: 
Haya mocher moded letoch kelyo shel lokeach lo kana sheen kelyo shel lokeach kone lo birshut harabbim. hayu happerot birshut hallokeach kevan shekkibbel alav hammocher limkor kana lokeach veaf al pi sheadayin lo madad. hayu birshut hammocher o birshut hammufkadin etzlo lo kana hallokeach ad sheyyagbiah happerot o ad sheyyotziem mershuto bischirut mekoman vechayyotze bo kemo shebbearnu: 
Hayu happerot besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem. vaafillu hayu birshut lokeach vehayu betoch kelyo shel mocher vekibbel alav hammocher limkor vehitchil hammocher limdod betoch kelyo shel mocher. im amar lo kor bishloshim sela ani mocher lecha yachol lachzor bo afillu bisa acharona hoil vaadayin happerot bechelav velo gamar kol hammidda vechelav shel mocher eno kone lallokeach af al pi shehu birshut hallokeach. veim amar lo kor bishloshim sea besela rishon rishon kana shekkevan sheppasku haddamim al kol sea usea kol sea sheyyagbiah hammocher viare otah nigmera mechiratah. hoil veen happerot birshut hammocher velo birshut hallokeach. veillu lo haya happerot bechelav shel mocher kevan shehen birshut lokeach kana mishsheppasak af al pi shello madad kemo shebbearnu: 
Vechen hammocher yayin o shemen lachavero besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem o birshut lokeach. vehayta hammidda shel sarsur. ad shello nitmallet hammidda hare hen shel mocher. mishshennitmallet hammidda hare hen birshut lokeach. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo: 
Vechen perot shehayu tzevurin besimta o bechatzer shel shenehem vehammidda enah shel echad mehen vehaya hammocher moded. ad shello nitmallet hammidda hare hi birshut hammocher. umishshennitmallet hammidda hare hi birshut lokeach: 
Hayta hammidda shel echad mehen. vehayu bah reshamin leda chetzyah. shelishah. ureviah. vechayyotze bahen. kevan shehiggia leroshem min harshamim kana rishon rishon. veaf al pi shello nitmallet hammidda. shekkol roshem mehem kemidda bifne atzmah. shehare shel echad mehen hi hammidda vehu somech al harshamim shebbah: 
Ze kelal gadol yihye beyadcha. hakkone et hammittaltelin im pasak haddamim veachar kach higbiah kana. veim higbiah techilla vehinniach veachar kach pasak haddamim lo kana beotah hagebaha ad sheyyagbiah achar sheppasak. o yimshoch davar sheen darko lehagebiah: 
Haya davar hannimkar damav ketzuvin viduin vehigbiho kanahu. af al pi sheppasak achar shehigbiah. vehu haddin bishar devarim shekkonin bahem et hammittaltelin shetztzarich liknot bahem achar sheyyifsok haddamim. ella im ken damav ketzuvin kemo shebbearnu: 
Lefichach hammoshech chammarim ufoalim vehichnisan letoch beto. im madad ad shello pasak haddamim afillu haya hallokeach hu hammoded. o sheppasak haddamim veachar kach madad hammocher. shenehem yecholin lachzor bahen. perkan hallokeach vehichnisan letoch beto. im pasak haddamim veachar kach madad hammocher en shenehem yecholin lachzor bahen shehare samcha dato limkor. veim madad ad shello pasak shenehem yecholin lachzor bahem shehare lo samcha dato adayin limkor. vaafillu madad hallokeach: 
Hannotel kelim min haumman al menat levakkeran. im hayu damav ketzuvin veneenas beyado chayyav bedamav. hoil vedamav ketzuvin meet shehigbiho naasa birshuto. vehu sheyyagbihennu kede liknot et kullo veyihye oto chefetz hannimkar chaviv al hallokeach. aval chefetz shehammocher katz bo vehu mevakkesh verodef lemachro hare hu birshut hammocher ad sheyyifsok haddamim veyagbihennu hallokeach achar sheppasak: 
Echad hammoshech o hammagbiah o hammachazik beatzmo o sheamar leacher lehagebiah o limshoch lo o lehachazik lo hare ze zacha lo. vechen bishar darche hakkeniyya:

Kol hammittaltelin konin ze et ze. ketzad. hechlif para bachamor o yayin beshemen af al pi shemmakpidin al haddamim veshiaru kamma shave ze vechamma shave ze veachar kach hechlifu. kevan shemmashach haechad o higbiho kana hashsheni hammittaltelin haacherim bechol makom shehem venaasu birshuto. veaf al pi sheadayin lo meshachan: 
Hechlif chamor befara vetale umashach happara vaadayin lo mashach et hattale lo kana sheen kan meshicha gemura. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Damim sheen makpidin alehem hare hen kishar mittaltelin vekonin. ketzad. hare shechafan maot belo mishkal uvelo minyan ella netalan achsara. veamar lo mechor li paratcha o yayin ze beellu venatan lo et haddamim kana veen echad mehem yachol lachzor bo. shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu velo hitzrichu bo meshicha: 
Vechen reuven shemmachar mittaltelin leshimon bachamishshim zuz. vekana shimon hammittaltelin venitchayyev bedamim. veachar shennitchayyev shimon bachamishshim zuz ellu haya lo yayin o behema o eved vechayyotze bahen mishshear hammittaltelin vehaya rotze lemachran. veamar lo reuven mechor oto li bachamishshim zuz sheyyesh li beyadcha deme hammecher veamar lo hen. kana reuven hammittaltelin bechol makom shehen veaf al pi shello mashach velo higbiah. sheggam ze davar sheeno matzuy hu velo hitzrichu bo meshicha. aval im haya chov lo alav shello mechamat hammecher veamar lo mechor li mittaltelin bachov sheyyesh li etzlecha veratzu shenehem. lo kana ad sheyyagbiah. o yimshoch davar sheen darko lehagebiah. o yikne beechad mehadderachim shehammittaltelin niknin bah: 
Hakkarkaot vehaavadim vehabbehema ushear kol hammittaltelin kol echad mehen nikne bachalifin vehu hannikra kinyan. veikkar hadderech hazzot sheyyitten hakkone lammakne keli kol shehu veyomar lo kene keli ze chelef hechatzer. o hayyayin. o habbehema. o haeved shemmacharta li bechach vechach. kevan shehigbiah hammocher et hakkeli vekanahu kana hallokeach oto hakkarka o otan hammittaltelin af al pi sheadayin lo meshachan velo natan haddamim. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo: 
En konin ella bechelim veaf al pi sheen bo sheve peruta. veen konin bedavar sheasur bahanaa. velo beferot velo bematbea. veen konin bechelav shel mocher ella bechelav shel lokeach: 
Hikna echad keli lammocher kede sheyyikne hallokeach oto hammimkar zacha hallokeach. veaf al pi shehikna lo hakkeli al menat lehacheziro nikna hammikkach vezacha bo hallokeach. shehammattana al menat lehachezir shemah mattana. af al pi shello tafas hammocher kol hakkeli shehiknahu chelef mimkaro ella achaz miktzato veachaz hammakne lo miktzato kana hallokeach. vehu sheachaz mimmennu kede shiur keli o yochazennu achiza shehu yachol lenattek et kol hakkeli miyyad hammakne lo. lefichach im hikna lo bemiktzat habbeged tzarich sheyyeechoz min habbeged shalosh etzbaot. sheim yifsok mimmakom sheachaz hare hu keli bifne atzmo. sheshshalosh etzbaot mibbeged karuy keli kemo shebbearnu beinyan tumat begadim. vechen im achaz pachot mishshalosh vehaya yachol lenattek kol hakkeli kana: 
Ze shekkotvin bishtarot vekanina mippeloni bichli hakkasher liknot bo. bichli lehotzi perot vechayyotze bahen. hakkasher lehotzi issure hanaa. liknot bo lehotzi kelyo shel mocher: 
Ze hakkinyan en tzarich lihyot bifne edim. ella im haya beno uven chavero kana. shello hitzricha tora edim bedine mamonot ella lechofer. aval hammocher o hannoten o hassocher o hammashil vechayyotze bahen en tzarich edim. vechevan shekkana hakkone bederech echad min hadderachim shekkonin bahen. ben behagebaha. ben bimshicha. ben bimsira. ben bekinyan. ben bechesef. ben bishtar o bachazaka kana. veaf al pi sheen sham edim: 
Hammocher o hannoten shekkanu miyyado yesh lechol echad mehen lachzor bo kol zeman sheoskin beoto inyan. veaf al pi shehakkinyan bifne edim. veim hifsik hainyan en echad mehem yachol lachzor af al pi sheen benehen edim. ucheshem shechozer hammocher vehannoten kach chozer hallokeach vehamekabbel kol zeman sheasukin beoto inyan ma sheen ken bishar darche hakkeniyya: 
Yesh devarim harebe sheenan tzerichin kinyan veen lekinyan bahem taam. kegon hameshachrer et avdo. vehamegaresh ishto. o ose shaliach. o hammoser modaa. o hamevattel modaa. o hammochel lachavero chov o pikkadon sheyyesh lo beyado. vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu: 
Nahagu rov hammekomot lehakenot lemiktzat ellu haddevarim o kayyotze beellu. veomrim vekaninu mippeloni sheasa peloni shaliach. o shemmachal lifloni chov sheyyesh lo etzlo. o shebbittel hammodaa shemmasar al get ze vechayyotze beellu. af al pi sheeno tzarich: 
Kinyan ze shennahagu lehakenot beellu haddevarim eno moil kelum. ella lehodia sheeno omer devarim ellu kimsachek umehattel ella sheggamar belibbo veachar kach amar. lefichach im amar belev shalem ani amarti vegamarti laasot davar ze en tzarich davar acher kelal: 
Haddevarim sheen bahen mammash en hakkinyan moil bahen. ketzad. hare shekkatav bishtar vekaninu mippeloni sheyyelech bischora im peloni. o sheyyachleku hassade shebbenehem. o sheyyishtattefu shenehem beummanut. vechayyotze bidvarim ellu kullan. hare ze kinyan devarim veeno moil kelum. shehare lo hikna lachavero davar mesuyyam veyadua. lo ikkar velo perot ikkar hayyadua:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 6:
Happerot af al pi sheen konin bahen kemo shebbearnu. hare niknin bekinyan kishar hammittaltelin. aval hammatbea keshem sheen konin bo kach eno nikne bekinyan. nimtza hammatbea eno nikne bekinyan veeno naase hu atzmo kinyan liknot kishar devarim: 
Leshonot shel zahav veshel kesef hare hen kaashashiyyot shel barzel o shel nechoshet. vehakkol kishar hammittaltelin hen. veniknin bekinyan vekonin ze et ze behachelafa kemo shebbearnu. aval hammatbeot shel kesef o dinarin shel zahav. o hammaot shel nechoshet. hare hen kullan damim keneged shear hammittaltelin. vehannoten et echad mehen deme hammittaltelin lo kana ad sheyyimshoch o yagbiah kemo shebbearnu. veen echad mehen nikne bekinyan velo naase kinyan: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shekkone shear mittaltelin beechad mimmine matbeot ellu o avadim vekarkaot. aval haddinarin shel zahav legabbe matbeot shel kesef hare hen keferot. vechen hammaot shel nechoshet kemo perot legabbe matbeot shel kesef: 
Ketzad. natan lo dinar shel zahav beesrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef nikne hakkesef af al pi sheadayin lo ba hakkesef leyado. vechayyav litten lo esrim vachamishsha dinar shel kesef kemo sheppasak immo. im chadashim chadashim im yeshanim yeshanim. aval im natan lo esrim vachamishsha kesef bedinar zahav lo kana ad sheyyikkach haddinar shel zahav. vechol echad yachol lachzor bo: 
Natan lo sheloshim isar shel nechoshet bedinar shel kesef. nikne haddinar shel kesef vechayyav litten lo kemo sheppasak immo. im dinar chadash chadash im yashan yashan. aval im natan lo dinar shel kesef bishloshim isar. lo kana ad sheyyikkach haisarot shel nechoshet. vechol echad mehen yachol lachzor bo: 
Vechen maot haraot sheppesalatan malchut o hammedina o dinarin sheenan yotzin beotah medina veen nosin venotnin bahen ad shemmeshannin otan lematbea acher. hare hen keferot lechol davar veniknin bekinyan. vekonin et hammaot. veen hammaot konot otan kishar kol happerot: 
Hammatbea en lo derech sheyyizke bo mi sheeno birshuto ella al gabbe karka. kegon shekkana hakkarka veal gabbo hammaot. o sheyyiskor et mekom hammaot. kevan shezzacha bakkarka bechesef o bishtar o bachazaka o bekinyan zacha bammaot. vehu sheyyihyu otan hammaot kayyamin kegon sheyyihyu mufkadin bemakom echad. aval reuven shehaya lo chov al shimon vehikna lelevi karka veal gabbah chov sheyyesh lo etzel shimon nire li shello kana hachov: 
Hayu omdim shelashtan veamar lo mane sheyyesh li beyadcha ben pikkadon ben milve tenehu laze. kana levi. veen echad mishshelashtan yachol lachzor bo. vedavar ze amru chachamim shehi halacha sheen lah taam lefichach en lemedin mimmenna ledin acher: 
Haya reuven chayyav leshimon mea zuz. veamar lelevi ten leshimon mea zuz ellu sheani chayyav lo ad sheetten lecha o ad sheeese immecha cheshbon. veamar lo hen vekibbel shimon. kol echad mishshelashtan yachol lachzor bo. vaafillu para levi leshimon miktzat chovo. lefichach im lo para levi leshimon chozer shimon vetovea et reuven bishar chovo: 
Hammocher shetar chov lachavero o netano lo bemattana. eno nikne bimsirat hashshetar leyado. shello masar lo ella haraya shebbo veen haraya nitpeset bayyad: 
Vechetzad yikne hashshetar. sheyyichtov lo hammakne kene shetar peloni vechol hashshibud sheyyesh bo veyimsor lo hashshetar venimtza shennikna bichtiva umesira. veen tzarich edim leinyan keniyyato aval tzarich edim leinyan teviato. shehare hannitba omer lo mi yomar shebbaal devarim shelli katav umasar lecha: 
Kinyan hashshetarot badderech hazzot middivre sofrim. aval min hattora en harayot niknot ella guf haddavar bilvad kanuy. lefichach hammocher shetar chov lachavero adayin yachol limchol. vaafillu yorsho mochalo: 
Haishsha shehichnisa shetar chov levaalah enah yechola limchol ella middaat balah mippene sheyyadah keyado: 
Hammakne lachavero karka kol shehu vehikna lo al gabbah shetar chov hare ze kana hashshetar bechol makom shehu belo ketiva uvelo mesira. venire li sheggam ze yachol limchol achar shemmecharo. vechen hammocher karka vechatav hashshetar veen hallokeach immo kevan shehechzik hallokeach bakkarka nikna hashshetar bechol makom shehu: 
Haomer zechu besade zo lifloni vechitvu lo et hashshetar vehechezik hazzoche lo bakkarka. yesh lannoten lachzor bashshetar ad sheyyaggia leyad baal hammattana. veaf al pi sheeno yachol lachzor bassade: 
Amar lahem zechu lo bassade al menat shettichtevu lo et hashshetar. af al pi shehechziku lo bassade chozer mizze umizze ad sheyyaggia shetar hammattana lide mekabbel hammattana:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 7: Mi shennatan haddamim velo mashach happerot. af al pi shello niknu hammittaltelin kemo shebbearnu. kol hachozer bo ben lokeach ben mocher lo asa maase yisrael vechayyav lekabbel mi sheppara. vaafillu natan haeravon kol hachozer mekabbel mi sheppara:

Vechetzad mekabbel mi sheppara. orrin oto bevet din veomrin mi sheppara meanshe dor hammabbul umeanshe dor happallaga umeanshe sedom vaamora umimmitzrayim shettavu bayyam hu yippara mimmi sheeno omed bedibburo. veachar kach yachzeru haddamim:

Hannoten deme hammittaltelin o miktzat haddamim vechazar bo hallokeach veamar lo hammocher bo vetol meotecha. hare hammaot etzlo kemo pikkadon. veim nignevu o avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan. aval im chazar bo hammocher hare hammaot birshuto vechayyav beacharayutan. veaf al pi shechazar bo veamar lallokeach bo vetol et shellecha. ad sheyyekabbel alav mi sheppara veyomar lo achar kach bo vetol et shellecha:

Mi shehaya lo chov etzel chavero veamar lo mechor li chavit shel yayin bachov sheyyesh li etzlecha veratza hammocher. hare ze kemi shennatan haddamim atta. vechol hachozer bo mekabbel mi sheppara. lefichach im machar lo karka bechovo en echad mehen yachol lachzor bo veaf al pi sheen meot hammalve metzuyot bishat hammecher:
Hallokeach mechavero karka o avadim o shear mittaltelin ufasku haddamim vehinniach mashkon al haddamim lo kana. vechol harotze lachzor mishshenehem chozer veeno chayyav lekabbel mi sheppara:

Machar lo bidvarim bilvad ufasku haddamim. verasham hallokeach roshem al hammikkach kede sheyyihye lo siman yadua shehu shello. af al pi shello natan mehaddamim kelum kol hachozer bo achar sherasham mekabbel mi sheppara. veim minhag hammedina hu sheyyikne haroshem kinyan gamur nikna hammikkach. veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. veyihye ze chayyav litten damim:
Davar barur hu sheen din ze ella besherasham bifne hammocher. o sheamar lo hammocher reshom mikkachacha. shehare gamar lehakenotan kemo shebbearnu bachazaka uvimshicha:

Hannose venoten bidvarim bilvad hare ze rauy laamod lo bedibburo af al pi shello lakach min haddamim kelum velo rasham velo hinniach mashkon. vechol hachozer bo ben lokeach ben mocher af al pi sheeno chayyav lekabbel mi sheppara hare ze mimmechussere amana veen ruach chachamim nocha hemennu:

Vechen mi sheamar lachavero litten lo mattana velo natan hare ze mimmechussere amana. bamme devarim amurim bemattana muetet shehare samcha dato shel mekabbel keshehivticho. aval bemattana merubba en bah chesron amana. shehare lo heemin ze sheyyitten lo devarim ellu ad sheyyikne otan bidvarim shekkonin bahen:
Hannoten maot lachavero liknot lo karka o mittaltelin vehinniach meot chavero etzlo vehalach vekana leatzmo bimotav ma sheasa asuy vahare hu mikkelal harammain:

Haya yodea shezze hammocher ohev oto umechabbedo umocher lo veeno mocher limshallecho hare ze muttar liknot leatzmo. vehu sheyyachazor veyodio. veim mefached shemma yavo acher vikaddemennu liknot hare ze kone leatzmo veachar kach modio:

Horu miktzat hammorim sheim kana leatzmo bimot chavero achar shezzekafan alav milve hare kana leatzmo. umekabbelin mimmennu kesheamar zakafti otam hammaot al atzmi bemilve. vaani omer sheen din ze din emet. ella hammikkach shel meshalleach kemo sheyyitbaer bedin haesek:

Shelosha shennatnu maot leechad liknot lahem hammikkach. im hayu hammaot meoravot vekana bemiktzat haddamim af al pi shehayta kavvanat hashshaliach shezze shekkana leechad mehen hare hammikkach shel kullan vecholkin oto lefi meotehen:
Hayu maot shel echad mehen tzerurin vachatumin af al pi shehaya belev hashshaliach hazze sheyyakne hammikkach lechullan lo kana ella ze shennikna hammikkach bimotav bilvad:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 8:
Hammocher sade lachavero beelef zuz venatan lo miktzat haddamim vehaya yotze venichnas vetovea shear haddamim afillu lo nishar lo ella zuz echad lo kana hallokeach et kullah af al pi shekkatav hashshetar o hechezik: 
Chazar bo hallokeach. yad hammocher al haelyona. ratza omer lo helach meotecha o kene min hakkarka keneged hammaot shennatatta li venoten lo min hazzibburit shebbah. veim chazar hammocher yad hallokeach al haelyona ratza omer lo ten li meotay o ten li karka keneged meotay venotel min hayyafe shebbah. veim lo haya yotze venichnas vetovea kana hallokeach et kullah veen echad mehen yachol lachzor bo. ushear haddamim alav kishar hachovot: 
Machar sadehu mippene raatah. af al pi shehu yotze venichnas vetovea shear haddamim kana hakkol. veen hallokeach yachol lachzor bo. shezze shettovea verodef lo mippene sheadayin lo gamar vehikna. ella kede shello yachzor bo hallokeach: 
Vechen haddin bemocher mittaltelin af al pi shemmashach hallokeach happerot vehotzian lirshuto vehammocher nichnas veyotze al shear haddamim lo kana. veyad hachozer bo al hattachtona kemo shebbearnu ella im ken machar mippene raat mimkaro vahare ze kana hakkol: 
Lakach sheve mea bematayim vehammocher yotze venichnas litboa shear haddamim. hare ze safek im hu kemocher sadehu mippene raatah veeno tovea ella mippene shemmachar beyoter. o eno kemocher sadehu mippene raatah veze shettovea mippene sheadayin lo gamar lehakenoto ad sheyyikkach kol haddamim. lefichach harotze lachzor mishshenehem eno yachol lachzor. veim tafas hammocher mimmikkach shemmachar keneged hammaot shennisharu lo en motziin miyyado: 
Hakkone davar mechavero venatan lo haddamim vetaa beminyan hammaot. uleachar zeman tevao hammocher veamar lo mea shennatatta li enam ella tishim. nikna hammikkach umachazir lo haasara afillu achar kamma shanim. ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin: 
Haomer lachavero kesheemkor sade zo hare hi mechura lecha meachshav bemea zuz vekana miyyado al kach uleachar zeman mecharah leacher bemea. kana harishon. mecharah beyoter al mane kana acharon. shello amar lo ella kesheemkor sheyyihye mocher middato techilla veze lo haya rotze limkor velo machar ella mippene hattosefet shehosif ze al shavyo. venimtza kemi shenneenas umachar: 
Amar lo kesheemkerenna hare hi kenuya lecha meachshav kema sheyyashumu otah bet din shel shelosha. afillu al pi shenayim min hashshelosha. amar lo kemo sheyyomru shelosha ad sheyyomru hashshelosha. vechen im amar lo kemo sheyyashumu otah bet din shel arbaa ad sheyyashumu haarbaa kullan veyaskimu veyimkor leacher kemo sheyyaskimu. veachar kach yikne harishon. shamu otah shelosha o arbaa veamar hammocher ad sheyyavou shelosha acherim o arbaa veyashumu en shomin lo shehare kanu miyyado techilla shemmachar meachshav:

Hammocher lahekdesh veamar lo haggizbar bechamma atta mocher chefetz ze veamar baasara afillu haya shave mea kevan sheamar baasara eno [yachol] lachzor bo. sheamira legavoah kimsira lehedyot: 
Haggizbar shekkana lahekdesh o shemmachar yado al haelyona. ketzad. natan damim shel hekdesh af al pi shello mashach happerot im hukeru kana kedin tora. veim huzelu happerot chozer shehare lo mashach. velo yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hahekdesh. vechen im machar chefetz shel hekdesh umeshacho hallokeach velo natan damim vehuzal hachefetz kana. shello yehe koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hekdesh. veim hukar hachefetz chozer bo shehare lo lakach haggizbar damim. vehahekdesh eno nikne ella bechesef shenneemar venatan hakkesef vekam lo. veen haggizbar chayyav lekabbel mi sheppara: 
Nichse yetomim hare hen kehekdesh. ketzad. yetomim shemmachru perot venimshechu mehen happerot vaadayin lo lakchu haddamim vehukeru happerot chozrin bahen. sheen nichse yetomim niknin ella bechesef kehekdesh. huzelu happerot lo yihye koach hedyot yoter chamur mikkochan: 
Vechen im lakchu haddamim vaadayin lo nimshechu perotehen vehukeru. chozrin kishar hahedyotot. aval im huzelu happerot veratzu hallakochot lachzor bahen. chozrin umekabbelin mi sheppara kedinam im shear haam. sheim nechayyev otam likkach happerot kedin tora hare zo raa laytomim. sheim yihye dinam kach kesheyyitztarchu limkor lo yimtzeu mi yitten lahem damim: 
Vechen yetomim shellakchu perot umashchu happerot velo natnu haddamim vehukeru lo yihye koach hedyot gadol mikkochan. veim huzelu happerot enan chozrin. shezzo raa lahem kesheyyitztarchu liknot perot lo yimtzeu mi sheyyimkor lahem: 
Natnu haddamim velo mashchu happerot vehuzzelu happerot chozrin. lo yihye koach hedyot gadol mikkochan. hukeru im ratzu hammochrim lachzor bahen chozrin umekabbelin mi sheppara. sheim yihye dinam sheyyiknu bintinat hammaot yomar lahem hammocher nisrefu happerot shellekachtem o avdu beones uchevar naasu birshutechem mishsheat netinat hammaot: 
Bearbaa perakim bashshana heemidu divrehem al din tora bevasar mippene shehaam kullan tzerichin levasar. veellu hen. erev yom tov haacharon shel chag. veerev yom tov harishon shel pesach. veerev haatzeret. veerev rosh hashshana. ketzad. haya lattabbach shor afillu shave mea dinarin velakach dinar echad min hallokeach kede litten lo basar kesheyyishchot velo nitkabbetzu lo kol deme hashshor eno yachol lachzor bo. ella mashchitin et hattabbach baal karcho. vechofin oto lishchot velitten habbasar lallokeach. lefichach im met hashshor met lallokeach:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 10:
Mi sheanasuhu ad shemmachar velakach deme hammikkach. afillu taluhu ad shemmachar mimkaro mimkar ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot shemmippene anso gamar umakne. af al pi shello lakach haddamim bifne haedim. lefichach im masar modaa kodem sheyyimkor veamar lishne edim deu shezze sheani mocher chefetz peloni o sade peloni lifloni mippene sheani anus. hare hammimkar batel. vaafillu hechezik kamma shanim motziin otah miyyado umachazir haddamim: 
Utzerichin haedim leda shehu mocher mippene haones veshehu anus vadday. lo sheyyismechu al piv. vechol modaa sheen katuv bah veanu haedim yadanu sheppeloni ze anus haya enah modaa: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher o beose peshara. aval bemattana o bimchila im masar modaa kodem mattana af al pi sheeno anus hare hammattana betela. sheen holchin bemattana ella achar gilluy daat hannoten sheim eno rotze lehakenot bechol libbo lo kana hamekabbel mattana. vehammechila mattana hi: 
Echad haones et chavero beshehikkahu o telaahu ad shemmachar o shehifchido bedavar sheefshar lo laasot ben bide akkum ben bide yisrael hare ze ones. umaase beechad shessachar pardes mechavero leeser shanim velo haya shetar chov beyad hammaskir veachar sheachalo hassocher shalosh shanim amar lo im lo timkerenu li echbosh shetar sechirut veeton shehu lakuach beyadi veamru chachamim shezze ones. vechen kol kayyotze baze. lefichach im tevao hammaskir bevet din vechafar bo vetaan shehappardes shello veachar kach masar hammaskir modaa veachar kach machar lassocher shekkafar bo hare hammimkar batel. shehare yesh lo edim shehu anus. vehem haedim shekkafar bifnehem bevet din vehem ede hammodaa. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Bamme devarim amurim beannas shehare hu chamsan mippene shekkofe et hammocher limkor shello birtzono. aval haggozel vehuchzak begazlan veachar kach lakach sade sheggazal en hammocher tzarich limsor modaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot gezela: 
Ede hammodaa yesh lahem lachtom hem atzman beoto hammimkar shennimsera lahem hammodaa alav veen bechach kelum. vaafillu amar lahem bifne haannas birtzoni macharti belo ones hare hammodaa kayyemet. keshem sheanaso shemmachar belo ratzon kach anaso ad sheamar birtzoni ani mocher: 
Vechen im hoda bifnehem shellakach haddamim achar shemmasar modaa al kach eno chayyav lehachezir kelum. shehaones anaso ad sheyyode vehaedim kevar yadu shehu anus. aval im mana haddamim bifnehem chayyav lehachezir: 
Heidu alav ede hammecher shebbittel hammodaa hare hammodaa betela. veim amar leede hammodaa heyu yodin shekkol kinyan sheani lokeach levattel hammodaa umodae demodae shehakkol batel veeni omer kach ella mippene haones sheattem yodin veen bedati lehakenot leze haannas leolam. hare hammecher batel. veaf al pi shekkanu miyyado levattel hammodaa al hadderech shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 11:
Hammaknne ben karka bin mittaltelin vehitna tenain sheefshar lekayyeman. ben shehitna hammakne ben shehitna hakkone. im nitkayyemu hattenain nikna haddavar shehukna. veim lo nitkayyem hattenay lo kana. uchevar bearnu mishpete hattenaim behilchot ishut: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshekkana bederech min hadderachim shekkonin bahen vahare yesh alav lekayyem et hattenay. aval im lo kana atta vehitna immo sheim nitkayyem hattenay ze yikne veim lo nitkayyem lo yikne af al pi shennitkayyem hattenay lo kana. shezzo asmachta hi. shehare samach keniyyato laasot kach vechach vechol asmachta enah kona shehare lo gamar belibbo lehakenoto: 
Ketzad. hammocher bayit lachavero o netano lo bemattana al menat sheyyelech immo lirushalayim beyom peloni. vehechezik ze babbayit. hare ze kana kesheyyelech immo lirushalayim beoto hayyom. veim avar oto hayyom velo halach lo kana. aval im hitna veamar lo im telech immi lirushalayim beyom peloni o im tavi li davar peloni etten lecha bayit ze o emkerenu lecha bechach vechach. vehalach immo beoto hayyom o shehevi lo. af al pi shehechzik babbayit achar shekkiyyem hattenay lo kana shezzo hi asmachta. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Lefichach hannoten eravon lachavero veamar lo im ani chozer bi ervoni machul lecha vehalla omer veim ani chozer bi echpol lecha ervoncha. im chazar bo hallokeach kana ze haeravon shehare hu tachat yado. veim chazar bo hammocher en mechayyevin oto lichpol haeravon shezzo asmachta hi veasmachta lo kana:
Vechen mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et hashshetar veamar lo im lo natatti lecha ad yom peloni ten lo shetaro vehiggia zeman velo natan lo. lo yitten hashshalish et hashshetar shezzo asmachta hi:
Vechen kol tenain shemmatnin bene adam benehen. af al pi shehen beedim uvishtar. im yihye kach o im taase kach etten lecha mane o akne lecha bayit ze. veim lo yihye o lo taase lo akne lecha velo etten lecha. af al pi sheasa o shehaya haddavar lo kana. shekkol haomer im yihye im lo yihye lo gamar vehikna. shehare dato adayin somechet shemma yihye o shemma lo yihye: 
Kol haomer kene meachshav en kan asmachta kelal vekana. sheillu lo gamar lehakenoto lo hiknahu meachshav. ketzad. im bati mikkan vead yom peloni kene bayit ze meachshav vekanu miyyado al kach. hare ze kana im ba betoch hazzeman shekkava. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shemmachar chatzero o sadehu. uferesh bishat hammechira shehu mocher kede lelech lemakom peloni o mippene hammatar shennimna kede liknot chittim bidme chatzero hare ze kemocher al tenay. lefichach im yarad hammatar achar shemmachar. o bau chittin vehuzelu. o nimna hadderech lelech leotah haaretz. o shello nistayyea lo laalot o liknot chittim. hare ze machzir otan haddamim vetachzor lo karka. shehare peresh sheeno mocher ella laasot davar peloni vahare lo naasa. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Aval hammocher setam af al pi shehaya belibbo shemmippene kach vechach hu mocher. veaf al pi shemmarin haddevarim sheeno mocher ella laasot kach vechach velo naasa eno chozer. shehare lo peresh udevarim shebballev enan devarim: 
Mi shehikna lachavero vehitna alav al menat shettitten mikkach ze o timkerenu lifloni. im netano o mecharo leoto peloni kana. veim lo kiyyem hattenay umecharo leacher o shello mecharo velo netano bazzeman shekkava lo lo kana. vechen hammocher o hallokeach shehitnu sheyyachzir lo hammikkach bizman peloni o kesheyyitten lo hammaot. hare hammecher kayyam veyachzir keshehitna: 
Machar karka lachavero vehitna hammocher veamar lallokeach kesheyyihyu li maot tachzir li hakkarka zo hare happerot shel mocher. machar lo setam veamar lo hallokeach middato kesheyyihyu lecha maot teviem li vaani achzir lecha karka zo. hare hattenay kayyam vehallokeach ochel perot. veen baze avak ribbit shehare middato chiyyev atzmo bitnay ze: 
Maase beishsha sheshshalcha reuven liknot lah chatzer mishshimon shehaya kerovo veamar shimon hammocher liruven hashshaliach im yihyu li maot tachzir li pelonit kerovati karka zo. veheshivo reuven veamar lo atta ufelonit kerovim kemo achim. kelomar haddavar karov shehi tachzir lecha veenah makpedet al zo. uva maase lifne chachamim veamru hare ze hashshaliach lo kana kelum shehare lo samcha dato shel karov ze al divre hashshaliach mippene shello heshivo teshuva berura venimtza shello gamar velo hikna. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Asmachta shekkanu miyyado aleha bevet din chashuv hare ze kana. vehu sheyyitpos zechuyyotav bevet din. vehu shello yihye anus: 
Ketzad. hare shehitpis shetaro o shovro bevet din. vekanu miyyado sheim lo ba beyom peloni yinnaten shetar ze levaal dino vehiggia hayyom velo ba hare ellu notnim. veim ikkevo nahar o choli millavo lo yittenu. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vehu sheyyihye bevet din chashuv: 
Hamechayyev atzmo bemamon leacher belo tenay kelal. af al pi shello haya chayyav lo kelum hare ze chayyav. sheddavar ze mattana hi veenah asmachta. ketzad. haomer leedim hevu alay edim sheani chayyav lifloni mane. o shekkatav lo bishtar hareni chayyav lecha mane af al pi sheen sham edim. o sheamar lo bifne edim hareni chayyav lecha mane bishtar. af al pi shello amar attem eday. hoil veamar bishtar hare ze kemi sheamar hevu alay edim vechayyav leshallem. af al pi sheshshenehem modim vehaedim yodim shello haya lo etzlo kelum. shehare chiyyev atzmo. kemo sheyyishtabed hearev. vechaze horu rov haggeonim: 
Chiyyev atzmo bedavar sheeno katzuv. kegon sheamar hareni chayyav lazun otcha o lechassot chamesh shanim. af al pi shekkanu miyyado lo nishtabed. shezzo kemo mattana hi veen kan davar yadua umatzuy shennetano bemattana. vechen horu rabbotay: 
Umippene ma happosek im ishto sheyyihye zan et bittah chayyav lezunah. mippene sheppasak bishat nissuin vehaddavar dome lidvarim hanniknin baamira: 
Keshehayu chachme sefarad rotzim lehakenot beasmachta kach hayu osin. konin mizze shehu chayyav lachavero mea dinarin. veachar shechiyyev atzmo konin mibbaal chovo shekkol zeman sheyyihye kach o sheyyaase kach hare hachov ze machul lo meachshav. veim lo yihye o lo yaase hareni tovo bemamon shechiyyev atzmo bo. veal derech zo hayinu osin bechol hattenain shebben adam leishto beshidduchin uvechol haddevarim haddomin lahem:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 12:
Asur lammocher o lakkone lehonot et chavero shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha al tonu". veaf al pi shehu over belo taase eno loke mippene shennittan lehishshavon. uven shehona bemezid ben shello yada sheyyesh bemecher ze honaya chayyav leshallem: 
Vechamma tehe honaya veyihye chayyav lehashiv. shetut beshave. ketzad. hare shemmachar sheve shesh bechamesh. o sheve sheva beshesh. o sheve chamesh beshesh. o sheve shesh besheva. hare ze honaya venikne hammikkach vechayyav hameanne leshallem et hahonaya ulehachazirah kullah lammitanne: 
Hayta hahonaya pachot mizze bechol shehu. kegon shemmachar sheve shishshim dinar bachamishshim uferuta. eno chayyav lehachezir kelum. shekkol pachot mishshetut derech hakkol limchol bo: 
Hayta hahonaya yetera al hashshetut bechol shehu. kegon shemmachar sheve shishshim bachamishshim pachot peruta. batel mikkach. vehammitanne yachol lehachezir hachefetz velo yikne kelal. aval hameanne oto eno yachol lachzor im ratza ze vekibbel. veaf al pi shebbatal hammikkach. en hameanne chayyav lehachezir ad shettihye hahonaya yeter al peruta. hayta peruta beshave eno machzir sheen honaya lifrutot: 
Ad matay yihye lo lachzor velitboa hahonaya o levattel hammikkach. ad kede sheyyare letaggar o likrovo. veim shaha yoter mizze afillu lakach sheve mea bematayim eno chozer: 
Bamme devarim amurim belokeach shehare hammikkach beyado umarehu. aval hammocher chozer behonaya leolam. veen tzarich lomar bevittul mikkach sheeno yodea deme ze shemmachar ad sheyyire kemoto shennimkar bashshuk. lefichach im haya hammikkach davar sheen bemino shinnuy vehu kullo shave kegon pilpelin vechayyotze bahen hare ze eno chozer ella ad kede sheyyishal al shaar shebbashshuk bilvad: 
Vechen im noda shebba leyado kemimkaro veyada shettaa velo tava eno yuchal lachzor velitboa shehare machal: 
Keshem shehonaya lehedyot kach honaya letaggar af al pi shehu baki. ucheshem shehonaya beferot uvivhema kach yesh din honaya bematbeot: 
Ketzad. hare shehaya dinar shel zahav beesrim vearbaa dinar shel kesef vetzerfa beesrim dinar o beesrim ushemona hare ze machzir et hahonaya. haya yater al ze batel hatztzeruf. pachot mikkan mechila: 
Vechen im haya hassela chasera shetut vehayu motziin hasselaim beminyan velo bemishkal machzir hahonaya: 
Ad matay chayyav lehachezir haddinar o hassela. bakkerakkim ad kede sheyyare lashshulchani. bichfarim sheen hashshulchani matzuy sham yesh lo lehachezir ad arve shabbatot. sheen makkir hassela vechesronah vedameha ella hashshulchani. vehu haddin lemocher sefarim avanim tovot umargaliyyot sheyyesh lallokeach lachzor ad sheyyare otam letaggarim habbekiim bahen bechol makom shehen. sheen hakkol bekiim bidvarim ellu. lefichach im lo haya makkir beotah medina veholich hammikkach lemakom acher. o shebba habbaki leachar zeman merubbe vehodio shettaa. hare ze chozer: 
Hannoten sela chasera lachavero im haya makkirah afillu leachar shenem asar chodesh hare ze machzirah. veim haya efshar lehotziah al yede haddechak eno yachol lehachezirah leachar zeman ella im ken kibbelah mimmennu bemiddat chasidut: 
Hammocher lachavero sheve arba bechamesh shehare hammikkach batel kemo shebbearnu velo hispik lehareot letaggar o likrovo ad shehukar veamad besheva. lokeach yachol lachzor bo velo hammocher. shehare hallokeach omer lammocher illu lo honetani lo hayita yachol lachzor veatta shehonetani tachzor heach yihye hachote niskar: 
Vechen mocher shemmachar sheve chamesh bearba vezal veamad beshalosh. mocher yachol lachzor bo velo lokeach. shehare omer lo hammocher lallokeach lo mippene shehonetani tachzor becha: 
Hammocher sheve chamesh beshesh velo hispik lehareoto ad shehukar veamad bishmone. hare hammocher chayyav lehachezir haachat shel honaya shehare nikna hammikkach vechayyav lehachezir ucheshehokir birshut lokeach hukar. vechen im machar shave shesh bechamesh vehuzelu veamdu al shalosh. hare hallokeach chayyav lehachezir sela achat shel honaya. shehare nikna hammikkach uvirshut hallokeach huzal:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 13:
Hammachlif kelim bechelim o behema bivhema afillu machat beshirayim o tale besus en lo honaya. shezze rotze bemachat yoter min hashshirayim. aval hammachlif perot beferot ben sheshshamu otam kodem hammechira ben sheshshamu otam achar mechira yesh lahen honaya: 
Hallokeach bedamim achsara kegon shechafan mimmaot veamar lo mechor li paratcha beellu. af al pi shekkone bachalifin kana umachazir honaa kemo shebbearnu. vehu haddin lelokeach perot achsara besela o bishtayim shekkana umachazir onaa. baal habbayit shemmachar kele tashmisho en lo honaya. sheillule lo hirbu lo haddamim lo haya mocher lo kele tashmisho: 
Haomer lachavero al menat sheen lecha alay onaya yesh lo alav honaya. bamme devarim amurim bistam sheen yodea kamma honaya yesh bo kede sheyyimchol. veen tzarich lomar im amar lo al menat sheen bo honaya shehare yesh bo. aval bimfaresh en lo honaya shekkol tenay shebbammamon kayyam: 
Ketzad. mocher sheamar lallokeach chefetz ze sheani noten bematayim yodea ani sheeno shave ella mane al menat sheen lecha honaya ani mocher lecha en lo alav honaya. vechen lokeach sheamar lammocher chefetz ze sheani lokeach mimmecha bemane yodea ani sheshshave matayim al menat sheen lecha alay honaya ani lokeach mimmecha. en lo alav honaya: 
Hannose vehannoten beemuna en lo alav onaya. ketzad. chefetz ze bechach vechach lekachtiv kach vechach ani mistakker bo. en lo alav honaya: 
Vhannose vehannoten beemuna im lakach kelim rabbim o begadim bemimkar echad. lo yachshov et hara beemuna veet hayyafe beshave ella ze veze beemuna o ze veze beshavin. veyesh lo lehaalot al hammikkach sechar hakkattaf. usechar hachammar. usechar pundak. aval sechar atzmo mippene shehu kefoel eno mosif oto al hammikkach. ella mefaresh veomer lo kach vechach ani mistakker: 
Haakkum en lo honaya shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "ish et achiv". veakkum shehona et yisrael machzir honaya bedinin shellanu. lo yihye ze chamur miyyisrael: 
Ellu devarim sheen lahem honaya. hakkarkaot vehaavadim vehashshetarot vehahekdeshot. afillu machar sheve elef bedinar o sheve dinar beelef en bahen honaya. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 25 14)</small> "o kano miyyad amitecha". davar hannikne miyyad leyad. yatzu hakkarkaot veyatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot. veyatzu shetarot sheen gufan kanuy ella liraya shebbahen. amitcha velo hekdesh: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemocher nichse atzmo. aval hashshaliach shettaa bechol shehu ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot chozer. venire li shekken haddin beappotroppos shettaa bechol shehu. ben bemittaltelin ben bekarkaot chozer. veeno dome levet din mippene shehu yachid: 
Bet din shemmachru nichse yetomim vetau ben bekarkaot ben bemittaltelin. im tau befachot mishshetut hare zo mechila kehedyot. tau bishtut batel hammikkach. veim ratzu shello levattel hammimkar veyachziru hahonaya machazirin. lo yihye koach hedyot chamur mehen: 
Nire li shebbet din shemmachru karka o avadim shel yetomim sheve mane bematayim. en hallokeach yachol lachzor bahen. lo yihye koach hedyot chamur mikkoach hayetomim. vechen haddin beappotroppos shemmachar karka vaavadim sheen hallokeach yachol lachzor behonaya kedin hahedyot: 
Haachin vehashshuttafin shechalku hammittaltelin hare hen kelakochot. pachot mishshetut nikne mikkach veen machzir kelum. yeter al shetut batel mikkach. shetut kana umachazir onaa. veim hitnu benehem sheyyachleku beshum haddayyanin vetau bishtut batla chaluka. shehaddayyanin sheshshamu ufachatu shetut o hotiru shetut michran batel: 
Habbehema vehammargalit vehassayif. vesefer tora hare hen kishar mittaltelin veyesh bahen honaya. en lecha davar sheen bo honaya chutz mearbaa devarim shemmanu chachamim. vehu sheyyihye mocher kone benichse atzmo kemo shebbearnu: 
Keshem sheen lekarkeot honaya kach sechirut karka en lo honaya. afillu sachar teraklin gadol bedinar beshana o refet ketanna bedinar bechol yom en lo honaya: 
Hassocher et happoel laasot immo ben bekarka ben bemittaltelin en lo honaya. mippene shehu kekone oto lizman. vaavadim en bahem honaya: 
Secharo lizroa lo karka veamar zarati bah zeria harauy bah uvau edim shezzara bah pachot min harauy lah. hare ze safek im yesh lo honaya mippene hazzera o en lo honaya mippene hakkarka. lefichach en motziin miyyad nitba. vechen en mashbiin oto ella shevuat hesset mippene tzad hakkarka sheyyesh kan: 
Hassocher et hakkelim o et habbehema yesh lahem onaya. shehassechirut mechira bat yomah hi. veim yesh bah honaya shetut o yoter. ben shennitanna socher ben shennitanna maskir. hare ze machzir honaya vaafillu leachar zeman merubbe: 
Nire li shehakkabbelan yesh lo honaa. ketzad. kegon shekkibbel alav leerog beged ze baasara zuzim. o litpor chaluk ze bishne zuzim. hare ze yesh lo honaya. vechol echad mishshenehem ben kabbelan ben baal habbeged chozer leolam kemocher:
Mishneh Torah, Sales 14:
Kevar bearnu shehannosi venotin beemuna veamar kach vechach ani mistakker en lo honaya. vaafillu amar ze lakachti besela uveeser ani mocher muttar. aval bet din chayyavin lifsok hashshearim ulehaamid shotrin lechach. velo yihye kol echad veechad mistakker kol ma sheyyirtze ella shetut bilvad yifseku lahem bischaram. velo yistakker hammocher yeter al shetut: 
Bamme devarim amurim bidvarim sheyyesh bahem chayye nefesh kegon yenot shemanim uselatot. aval haikkarin kegon hakkosht vehallevona vechayyotze bahen en poskin lahem shaar ella yistakker kol ma sheyyirtze: 
Veen mistakkerin paamayim bevetzim ella hattaggar harishon hu mochran besachar vehallokeach mimmennu mochran bekeren bilvad:

Rashshain bene hair lakotz lahem shaar lechol davar sheyyirtzu vaafillu basar velechem ulehatnot benehem lechol mi sheyyaavor yaanshu oto kach vechach:

Hammocher lachavero bemidda bemishkal o beminyan vetaa bechol shehu chozer leolam. sheen honaya ella bedamim aval becheshbon chozer: 
Ketzad. machar lo mea egozim bedinar venimtzeu mea veechad o tishim vetisha. nikna hammikkach umachazir et hattaut vaafillu leachar kamma shanim. vechen im nimtzeu hammaot chaser o yater min hamminyan sheppasku chozer vaafillu leachar shekkanu miyyado shello nishar lo etzel chavero kelum chozer shekkinyan betaut hu. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Vechen hammocher lachavero karka o eved o behema o shear mittaltelin venimtza bammikkach mum shello yada bo hallokeach. machziro afillu leachar kamma shanim shezze mikkach taut hu. vehu shello yishtammesh bammikkach achar sheyyada bammum. aval im nishtammesh bo achar sheraa hammum hare ze machal veeno yachol lehachezir: 
En mechashshevin pechat hammum. afillu machar lo keli shave asara dinarin venimtza bo mum hammafchito middamo isar machzir et hakkeli veeno yachol lomar lo helach isar pechat hammum. shehallokeach omer bechefetz shalem ani rotze. vechen im ratza hallokeach likkach pechat hammum harshut beyad hammocher. shehu omer lo o tikne oto kemo shehu o tol damim shellecha velech:
